fileCount.description: Number of log files included in the bundle.

totalBytes.description: Total uncompressed bytes of the included log files.

truncated.description: True when the read cap was hit and the bundle is a bounded subset (surfaced to the user).

includedEnvironment.description: Whether allowlisted environment info was included.
